capability: The builder never judges its own work
title: Fresh eyes try to break it.

hook.picture: Close: the whale's eyes sweep its own line twice, sliding over a small gap. A pod answers ✕ at the gap.
hook.words: I checked my own work twice.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I checked my own work twice. I still missed the obvious.

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three builder whales each check their own line. Three times, faster each time, a pod answers ✕ at the gap each maker saw past.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: The maker sees what they meant.

stakes.body: Self-review ships the mistakes the maker can't see, and a reader or reviewer finds them in public.

solution_hint: Let someone who didn't build it check.

metaphor.body: Pods that didn't draw the line try to break it. A poke counts only with a tick of evidence, and a different pod fixes what they find.

steps.picture: Three fresh pods swim in. None of them drew this line.
Each pod pokes the line. One poke lands on the gap with a tick: a ring around it, the evidence.
steps.words: Someone else tries to break it.

steps.picture: Push-in: a poke with no tick fades out. It is struck.
The struck poke is gone. Only ticked findings remain, ringed.
steps.words: No evidence? The finding is struck.

steps.picture: A fixer pod, not the builder and not a checker, patches the ringed gap.
The three checkers poke again, and the line holds.
steps.words: Fresh checkers with evidence: a jury.

real_case.claim: Round 1 of Manu's jury: 57 rows, 0 struck → 14 P0 · 28 P1 · 8 P2. After separate fixers and a fresh round, the final re-run was 116 passed, 0 failed.

honest_limit.picture: Three same-colour checker pods all face one way. A smudge behind them passes, and a downstream pod answers ✕.
honest_limit.words: Same-family checkers share a blind spot.

not_this.body: Judges agreeing is not the same as right.

ending_pattern.body: The whale steps back from the line it checked twice. A fresh pod's poke lands on the gap with a tick, and another pod closes it.
ending_pattern.callback: Same close framing and gap as bar 1: the gap the builder missed is found by someone else.

end_belief.body: Never let the builder be the judge.

sound.signature: A woodblock knock followed by a dry tick: a finding with evidence
sound.problem_motif: A knock with no tick, decaying into nothing

score_self.reason: Clear builder-versus-checker split, and an honest limit grounded in the one-model-family caveat. Pods playing three roles (checker, fixer, receiver) may blur on a phone.
